species.real: Bristol's best-known street artist, Banksy, has never been officially named, and the city has kept and even protected some of his walls.
species.name: Stencilette

dex.text: Turns up on a wall overnight, already finished, and nobody saw who did it. After dark it peels itself off the bricks and wanders off to find a better wall.
dex.fact: Bristol is famous for its street art, which grew out of the city's 1980s graffiti and sound-system scene; the Upfest festival in Bedminster has painted the streets since 2008.
